answer: Each identity may register only one walnut mold, identified by the hash of an exclusive pattern book that cannot be restaked. Payment issues only for a piece whose ember scar — the hash of its cooling-mark image — is unused across the whole registry; a colliding scar is refused and the posting deposit is slashed from that mold. Paid scars must be stacked as a summit sequence, each extending a running checksum of height; if any checksum step was already filed under another mold, the stack is voided as copied work.
